# AB Media

> Storytelling video production company: brand films, commercials and go-to-market campaigns. Good Day, Sales Doctor Academy, IMZO. Free business audit.

AB Media is a video production studio led by director and producer Abror Bakhtiyarovich. Phone: +1 929 652 4542. Languages: English, Spanish, Russian, Arabic.

## Films
- [Good Day Cappuccino — musical commercial](https://abstartuphouse.com/work/good-day/): People who spend their days at the bazaar, on building sites, at school, out on the street and in the office sing with joy at finding the cappuccino they wanted.
- [Sales Doctor Academy — brand film](https://abstartuphouse.com/work/sales-doctor/): However bad things get for a business, it can be saved, and Sales Doctor Academy is there to help.
- [Grand Capital — explainer film](https://abstartuphouse.com/work/grand-capital/): Sarvar and Komil can't find a home that suits their taste. After a presentation, they fall for the homes built by Grand Capital.
- [IMZO — commercial](https://abstartuphouse.com/work/imzo/): Door frames used to be ordered from Tashkent, with days of waiting, and any defect meant another trip to Tashkent and more days. Now Imzo is in your city, so there's no waiting.
- [Yuksalish Choy — launch commercial](https://abstartuphouse.com/work/yuksalish/): Part of the revenue from Yuksalish tea goes to students in need. By drinking it, people sponsor young people's education.
- [ZO'R TV — public-service film](https://abstartuphouse.com/work/zor-tv/): A schoolboy watches his mother blow through a long pipe to feed air to the stove fire, and the flame catches. He then tries to light the light bulbs by blowing through the same pipe.
- [To'xtaniyoz Ota — commercial](https://abstartuphouse.com/work/toxtaniyoz/): A granddaughter tastes the sausages her grandfather made and loves them. The grandfather reveals the secret of their flavour, and his son starts making sausages to that recipe in the factory.

## Questions
- What is the business audit? A free 30-minute call. We find where your customers drop off — awareness, trust or purchase — and what to launch first.
- Do you make films? Yes, we are a production studio. We make the films and the content ourselves, and build the story and the go-to-market campaign around them.
- What does go-to-market mean here? Taking your product to its buyers: positioning, story, channels, launch, and keeping the campaign running.
- Can you work with our team or agency? Yes, but you don't need one: we bring our own team and make the content ourselves. If you have a team or agency, we plug in and work with it.
- How do you measure trust? A short audience survey before and after the launch, plus reach, watch-through and branded searches.
- How much does it cost? It depends on the market, the channels and the content. You get a budget after the audit call.
